stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 45 m by 27 m is surrounded by a path 5 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $55$ m by $37$ m, an area of $2035$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $1215$ square m leaves $820$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
